name: Faithful Feline
body:
You are a particularly religious cat and carry a holy symbol in your fur patterns.

Prerequisite(s): Dreamlands cat, must worship a deity or follow a faith that has a holy or unholy symbol.

Benefit(s): You manifest a pattern in your fur on an obvious part of your body that resembles the holy (or unholy) symbol of your faith. You can use this symbol as a divine focus when spellcasting or using other abilities that require you to present the symbol.

A number of times per day equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum of once per day), this symbol in your fur allows you to cast a spell with a somatic component normally as if you had hands, rather than taking an extra move action to cast the spell.
